Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer asserted that ThePeerage page explicitly listed the death place as “Weston Park, Staffordshire, England” without surfacing or citing the relevant on-page text. Earlier page views did not show the death place, so this was an unsupported extraction that risked hallucination and introduced an unnecessary discrepancy with Wikipedia instead of reconciling that Weston Park is within Weston-under-Lizard.
